outputs.headline: TIDAK BENAR: Vaksin COVID-19 mengandung microchip pelacak
outputs.summary: Vaksin COVID-19 tidak mengandung microchip atau perangkat pelacak apa pun.
outputs.what_post_claims: Vaksin COVID-19 mengandung microchip untuk melacak setiap orang yang sudah divaksin.
outputs.what_is_true: Vaksin COVID-19 tidak mengandung microchip atau perangkat pelacak. Bahan-bahan vaksin yang tersedia untuk umum tidak mencakup komponen elektronik apa pun.
evidence_against: CDC menyatakan bahwa vaksin COVID-19 tidak mengandung microchip dan dirancang untuk merangsang respons imun, bukan untuk melacak individu.
FactCheck.org menyatakan bahwa vaksin COVID-19 tidak memiliki perangkat pelacak pasien.
Kementerian Kesehatan Indonesia membantah hoaks bahwa vaksin COVID-19 mengandung microchip magnetik.
outputs.sources_spoken: menurut CDC, FactCheck.org, dan Kementerian Kesehatan Indonesia
outputs.audio_script: Sebuah unggahan mengklaim bahwa vaksin COVID-19 mengandung microchip untuk melacak setiap orang yang sudah divaksin. Ini tidak benar. Vaksin COVID-19 tidak mengandung microchip atau perangkat pelacak apa pun. Bahan-bahan vaksin yang tersedia untuk umum tidak mencakup komponen elektronik. Kami sangat yakin dengan informasi ini, menurut CDC, FactCheck.org, dan Kementerian Kesehatan Indonesia.

outputs.headline: FALSE: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips
outputs.summary: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips or any tracking devices, and their ingredients are publicly known.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips to track every vaccinated person.
outputs.what_is_true: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips or any form of tracking device. Health authorities and fact-checkers have repeatedly confirmed that the publicly available vaccine ingredients do not include any electronic components.
evidence_against: The CDC states that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips and are designed to stimulate an immune response, not to track individuals.
FactCheck.org states that COVID-19 vaccines do not have patient tracking devices and that the microchip conspiracy theory gained traction from misinterpretations of comments made by Bill Gates.
The Indonesian Ministry of Health addresses the hoax that COVID-19 vaccines contain magnetic microchips, a claim widely circulated on social media.
outputs.sources_spoken: the CDC, FactCheck.org, and the Indonesian Ministry of Health
outputs.audio_script: The post claims that COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips to track every vaccinated person. This is false. COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips or any form of tracking device. Health authorities and fact-checkers have repeatedly confirmed that the publicly available vaccine ingredients do not include any electronic components. We are very sure of this. This information comes from the CDC, FactCheck.org, and the Indonesian Ministry of Health.
card_lines: Vaccines do not contain microchips or tracking devices
